title: Former Hells Angels president frozen for 10 minutes

tellings.quote: >> the former president of its large chapter of the Hells Angels was there as attending security.

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a ranch known for reports of strange events, says a man who had once led a large chapter of the Hells Angels motorcycle club was working there as security when he was left frozen, unable to move, for about ten minutes behind a building called Homestead 3. Fugal tells it as something that happened on his property, and as one of the ranch's unexplained effects on people.
